name: interior minimum and evaluation budget
test:
import math
calls = []
def f(x):
    assert -10 <= x <= 10
    calls.append(x)
    return (x-2)**2
x = minimize_convex(f, -10, 10, 1e-5)
assert abs(x-2) <= 1e-5
assert len(calls) <= math.ceil(math.log(20/1e-5)/math.log((1+math.sqrt(5))/2))+2
print("ok")

name: endpoint minima
test:
assert abs(minimize_convex(lambda x: x, -3, 7, 1e-5)+3) <= 1e-5
assert abs(minimize_convex(lambda x: -x, -3, 7, 1e-5)-7) <= 1e-5
print("ok")

name: plateau and nonsmooth minimum
test:
x = minimize_convex(lambda x: max(0, abs(x)-2), -9, 8)
assert -2-1e-6 <= x <= 2+1e-6
assert abs(minimize_convex(lambda x: abs(x-0.25), -1, 1)-0.25) <= 1e-6
print("ok")

name: degenerate and already narrow interval
test:
def forbidden(x):
    raise AssertionError("unnecessary evaluation")
assert minimize_convex(forbidden, 3, 3) == 3
x = minimize_convex(lambda x: x*x, 0, 1e-8)
assert 0 <= x <= 1e-8
print("ok")
